title: AI Receptionist for Small Business – demo site

build.text:
BUILD NOTES
Next.js (App Router, static export), Vercel or Cloudflare Pages. Not Astro.
llms.txt + llms-full.txt like JobsLocked.
One H1 per page, question-style H2s, answer-first paragraphs (AI Overviews quote these).
CTA = Start for $97 (GHL order form / Stripe) + Call the demo line. No long forms.
Placeholders in [BRACKETS] need real values: demo number, overage rate, go-live time.
